name: list_repository_workflows
summary: the workflows a repository has, a page at a time.

name: get_workflow
summary: a workflow, by id or file name.

name: dispatch_workflow
summary: starts a workflow that runs on `workflow_dispatch`.

name: enable_workflow
summary: turns a disabled workflow back on.

name: disable_workflow
summary: turns a workflow off, so nothing starts it until it is enabled again.

name: list_workflow_runs
summary: a repository's workflow runs, newest first, a page at a time.

name: list_workflow_run_jobs
summary: the jobs of a workflow run, a page at a time.

name: get_workflow_job_logs
summary: the plain-text logs of a finished workflow job.

name: rerun_workflow
summary: runs every job of a workflow run again.

name: rerun_failed_jobs
summary: runs again the jobs of a workflow run that failed, and the jobs that depend on them.

name: cancel_workflow_run
summary: stops a workflow run that is queued or in progress.

name: list_workflow_run_artifacts
summary: the artifacts a workflow run kept, a page at a time.

name: download_workflow_artifact
summary: where an artifact's ZIP archive can be downloaded: a signed URL GitHub keeps valid for one minute.
